name: Flying Press
description: This move combines Flying in its type effectiveness against the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Can be copied by Mirror Move.
Prevented from being executed or selected during Gravity's effect.
Can target a Pokemon positioned anywhere in a Triple Battle.
Prevented from being executed or selected in a Sky Battle.
